title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters 14 Nov #164 ~ 1992 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics
descriptionText:
Dive into the complex and satirical world of "Cerebus the Aardvark" with issue number 164, titled "Mothers & Daughters," published in November 1992. Known for his unique blend of humor and storytelling, Dave Sim's creation continues to captivate readers with its storytelling that defies conventional genres.

This comic book is a treasure for enthusiasts of modern age comics and collectors alike. It emerges from the renowned Aardvark-Vanaheim publisher, guaranteeing a piece of comic history. Rich in narrative and illustrated with the iconic character Cerebus, this issue is a must-have for anyone looking to complete their series collection.
